clips.title: The story
paras: Orgrimmar's stores gather supplies for the Horde's campaign across Kalimdor. Workers earn commendation signets for their contributions, and Warlord Gorchuk exchanges them for supplies to equip the fighters.

Across Kalimdor, the Horde gathers raw goods, weapons, and provisions for a vast campaign. Gatherers and tradesfolk bring bandages, metals, and herbs into the cities, where military overseers award commendation signets for their work. The tokens mark each contribution to the stockpile growing along Orgrimmar's central avenues.

Warlord Gorchuk knows the wider war effort needs supplies, but each warrior also needs gear and provisions to survive the march into battle. Fighters can trade their commendation signets back into the Horde's stores for field supplies and surplus materiel, giving up personal recognition for what they need on the front.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, here for additional supplies for yourself, are you? Well, I can certainly understand the need for additional materiel... Just take a look around if you need any proof.

I'll issue you some additional supplies, but you'll need to give me an appropriate number of commendation signets in exchange. You won't receive any recognition for surrendering the signets in this manner, but you might find something useful that will help keep you alive when battle is finally upon us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well then, it's settled; here are your supplies, adventurer. If you wish to do an additional exchange, then I am prepared to authorize it. Just give me the word and I'll make it happen.
Keep up the good work, friend. We need all the materiel we can muster if we're going to win this thing. If we all do our part, then victory shall be ours for the taking!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
